scope.summary: Both changes add depth checks to array and object printing. The harness parses input and calls printing, but the supplied evidence does not show how parsed values reach those printers. Coverage and overall sufficiency remain unresolved.

assessments.reason: The new check is in print_array. The harness prints parsed values, but parse_value is missing, so the route from accepted input to an array printer is unproven.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Dispatches array values to the changed printer.
Shows parsing before a value is returned to the harness.

build.reason: The harness build delegates to fuzzing/ossfuzz.sh, whose contents were not supplied; its compiler and link steps cannot be checked.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the library build configuration the delegated recipe may use.

input.reason: The entry admits a finite NUL-terminated payload after four binary flags and passes that payload to the string parser, which measures its length and invokes the length-aware parser.

evidence.dependency_reason: Defines how the parser receives the harness payload.

lifecycle.reason: The harness frees printed text and deletes the parsed tree. The supplied code shows the return and cleanup paths, but omits global_hooks initialization needed to establish that free matches the default allocator.

evidence.dependency_reason: Buffered printing allocates and returns memory through global_hooks.
Deletes the parsed tree through global_hooks.

control_flow.reason: The entry calls parsing and three printing variants, and print_value dispatches array and object values. The missing parse_value body prevents tracing accepted input to those value types.

evidence.dependency_reason: Calls the missing parse_value body and returns its result.
Routes parsed array and object values to the changed printers.

missing_information: Full body of parse_value in cJSON.c, including its dispatch to parse_array and parse_object.
Definition of CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT in cJSON.h or cJSON.c.
Initialization of global_hooks and cJSON_InitHooks in cJSON.c, to verify allocator compatibility.
